title: 第14章 西行之路

content_zh:
他肚子里有一只鹅，已经吃的饱饱的，可他心里更想吃掉另一只鹅。那只高高在上的，月华桂树下徘徊的白天鹅。水舞的不幸遭遇，固然令他同情和义愤，但更激起了他赢得美人归的信心。
叶小天狠狠地发了一个帮他预备媳妇儿出气的宏大志愿:“老子一定娶她过门，和她生上一堆大胖小子，领着老婆孩子回她故乡，好好羞臊羞臊孩子他姥爷和舅舅，他们不是怕丢人么，我就让他们丢人丢到姥姥家！”
炕上有低低的细语声传来，依照习惯，乐遥正缠着娘亲给她讲故事哄她入睡，这是她贫瘠无聊的童年生活中唯一的乐趣。
叶小天躺在土台上，隐隐约约听出水舞所讲的是《西游释厄传》，这个故事写成不久，却已风靡一时，叶小天在京城时也听说书先生讲过，不想竟已在此地流传开来。
渐渐的，水舞讲故事的声音越来越小，终至不可复闻，乐遥睡着了，水舞讲着讲着也睡熟了，房间里顿时静下来，叶小天从破露的屋顶一角，用一双倦眼最后望了一眼寂静的夜空。
夜空中，点点繁星一闪一闪的仿佛一双温柔美丽的眼睛，叶小天看着那一颗颗美丽的星辰，忽然就想到了薛水舞那双柔美似水的眸子。“我媳妇儿，可真俊呢。”叶小天想着，带着满意的微笑，睡着了。
起得很早的小萝莉绕着仰躺如蛤蟆的叶小天，仿佛正在扮着孙悟空，手舞足蹈地……
薛水舞火烧屁股地从灶台前冲过来，红着脸呵斥乐遥：“去去去，一边儿玩去，别吵醒了哥哥。”
“老娘又在教训哥哥了吧，大概小安又尿炕了，呵呵……”
睡梦中的叶小天依稀又回到了自己的家，童年的家。一大早，他还在熟睡，耳边就想起了老娘教训小安的声音。很熟悉的童年感觉啊，就连那饭香也一模一样……
“饭香？”
叶小天吸了吸鼻子，忽然张开眼睛，一睁眼就看到微白的天空，他的神识渐渐清醒过来。叶小天翻身坐起，就看到正在灶间烧火的水舞：“啊，你怎么起这么早？”
“你醒了？”水舞抬头看了他一眼，又飞快地把下巴埋进胸口：“哦，我担心天大亮后再生起炊烟会被村民们看到，所以早些起来。”
“哥哥哥哥，你起来啦，来陪遥遥玩！”乐遥闻声赶来，骑着只存在于她想象中的白龙马，非常快乐。
看着她快乐的样子，叶小天马上也快乐起来。灶间有一道温柔贤淑的忙碌的身影，破房子里有一个快乐玩耍的孩子，很温馨的感觉，这就是叶小天想要的生活。
“我一定要把她们安全地带回京城去！”叶小天愉快地想着，从神坛上一跃而下，仿佛浑身都充满了力量。
西方有位费先生，认为人的心灵深处总有一股动力驱使他的一切行为，这个动人就是人的原欲，原欲作为一种生物本能，如同饥饿一样，需要获得满足。
不同的是，饥饿感的满足只需要填饱肚子，而要满足原欲，由于外在道德等原因的限制，则不一定通过动物本能的方式来渲泄，他会把原欲转化为其他的方式来渲泄，诸如雄心壮志、诸如好奇心、诸如求知欲、破坏欲、攻击性等等,甚至转化升华为文明的创造源泉。
对此刻的叶小天来说，他想满足原欲的方式不是简单粗暴的占有，而是通过更委婉的更合乎人类文明的方式－－－－求偶来进行，他要做的显然就更复杂、也更多。
早上吃饭时，叶小天发现薛水舞似乎没有睡好，她那双漂亮的杏眼里有着隐隐的血丝。

“莫非因为英俊潇洒如我这般少年与她同屋而眠，所以令这美人儿难以入睡了？”一向自我感觉极其良好的叶小天沾沾自喜地想，马上对未来充满了更加美好的憧憬。
三人用过早餐，将剩下的肉沥干，摘了几片芭蕉叶子裹好，和白薯一起放在包袱里，穿过小镇继续西行。天还太早，村民们没有这么早起来的，村中街道上静悄悄的，有晨雾袅袅弥漫。
一户人家院子里，一个胖大妇人，披头散发，叉着她那能劈成三个薛水舞的肥硕腰肢，乜着一墙之隔的邻居家破口大骂：“不要面皮的贼儿娃子，连我家正下蛋的大白鹅都偷，一定生孩子没屁.眼儿！”

content_en:
There was a goose in his belly and he was already full, but in his heart he wanted to eat the other goose. That high, white swan lingering under the laurel tree. Shui Wu's misfortune certainly made him sympathize and indignant, but it also aroused his confidence in winning the beauty back.
Ye Xiaotian made a serious wish to help him prepare a wife to vent his anger on: "I will definitely marry her, have a bunch of fat boys with her, take my wife and children back to her hometown, be so ashamed of the children, her grandfather and uncle, aren't they afraid of embarrassment, I will let them be embarrassed and thrown to grandma's house!"
There was a low whisper on the kang. According to custom, Leyao was pestering her mother to tell her stories to lull her to sleep. This was the only joy in her barren and boring childhood.
Ye Xiaotian was lying on the earth platform and vaguely heard that what Shui Wu was talking about was "The Legend of Journey to the West". This story was written not long ago, but it has become popular. Ye Xiaotian also heard Mr. Shu tell it when he was in the capital, and unexpectedly it has already spread here.
Gradually, the voice of Shui Wu telling stories became smaller and smaller, and finally could no longer be heard. Leyao fell asleep, and Shui Wu fell asleep while talking. The room suddenly became quiet, and Ye Xiaotian took one last look at the silent night sky with a pair of tired eyes from the exposed corner of the roof.
In the night sky, the stars twinkled like a pair of gentle and beautiful eyes. Ye Xiaotian looked at the beautiful stars and suddenly thought of Xue Shuiwu's soft, watery eyes. "My wife is so handsome." Ye Xiaotian thought, and fell asleep with a satisfied smile.
The little Loli who got up very early circled Ye Xiaotian, who was lying on his back like a toad, as if he was pretending to be Sun Wukong, dancing...
Xue Shuiwu rushed over from the stove with a burning face, and scolded Leyao with a red face: "Go, go, play while you're at it, don't wake up my brother."
"I must be teaching my brother a lesson again. Xiao An probably peed on the bed again, haha..."
In his sleep, Ye Xiaotian vaguely returned to his home, his childhood home. Early in the morning, while he was still asleep, he remembered his mother's voice teaching Xiao An a lesson. It's a very familiar childhood feeling, even the smell of the rice is exactly the same...
"Fragrant rice?"
Ye Xiaotian sniffed and suddenly opened his eyes. As soon as he opened his eyes, he saw the pale sky, and his consciousness gradually regained consciousness. Ye Xiaotian turned over and sat up, and saw Shui Wu who was lighting the fire in the stove: "Ah, why did you get up so early?"
"Are you awake?" Shui Wu looked up at him and quickly buried her chin into her chest: "Oh, I'm worried that the villagers will see the smoke coming out after dawn, so I got up early."
"Brother, brother, get up and come play with Yaoyao!" Leyao heard the sound and rushed over, riding a white dragon horse that only existed in her imagination, very happy.
Seeing her happy look, Ye Xiaotian immediately became happy too. There is a gentle and virtuous busy figure in the kitchen, and there is a child playing happily in the dilapidated house. It feels very warm. This is the life Ye Xiaotian wants.
"I must bring them back to the capital safely!" Ye Xiaotian thought happily, and jumped down from the altar, as if his whole body was full of strength.
There is a Mr. Fei in the West who believes that there is always a driving force deep in the human soul that drives all his actions. This moving force is human primordial desire. As a biological instinct, primordial desire, like hunger, needs to be satisfied.
The difference is that the satisfaction of hunger only requires filling one's stomach, while the satisfaction of sexual desire, due to external moral restrictions and other reasons, may not necessarily be expressed through animal instincts. He will transform sexual desire into other ways to vent, such as ambition, curiosity, thirst for knowledge, desire for destruction, aggression, etc., and even transform and sublimate it into the creative source of civilization.
For Ye Xiaotian at this moment, the way he wants to satisfy his original desire is not through simple and crude possession, but through a more subtle way that is more in line with human civilization——When it comes to courtship, what he has to do is obviously more complicated and more.
When eating in the morning, Ye Xiaotian noticed that Xue Shuiwu didn't seem to have slept well, and there were faint bloodshot eyes in her beautiful almond eyes.
"Is it because a handsome and handsome young man like me is sleeping in the same room with her, so this beauty has trouble falling asleep?" Ye Xiaotian, who always felt very good about himself, thought smugly, and was immediately filled with a better longing for the future.
The three of them had breakfast, drained the remaining meat, picked a few banana leaves, wrapped them, put them in the bag with the sweet potatoes, and continued westward through the town. It was still too early, and the villagers did not get up so early. The streets in the village were quiet and filled with morning mist.
In the yard of a house, a fat woman with disheveled hair crossed her waist, which could be split into three pieces, and cursed at the neighbor's house across the wall: "You shameless thief, you even steal the big white goose that is laying eggs in my house, you must have a child with no eyesight!"
